messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Canary anomalies detected for routing-service in ap-south1. Error spike 11% and increased p95 latency. Automatic pause engaged, requesting expedited action: pin to stable image or abort rollout.

sam: Copy. Any customer-facing impact reported yet?

marco: A few customers reported degraded responses. Traces point to a regression in the new routing optimizer in v2.0.1-canary.

tanya: My read: pin to redwood/routing:v2.0.0-stable and scale down canary. Ops, can you escort and confirm health for 20m?

ops_oncall: I can supervise. If we pin, I'll monitor error_rate, p95 latency, and CPU. If anything stays >5% over baseline after 10m, we escalate to SRE.

sam: Running pin now:
```
/releasebot pin --service routing-service --image redwood/routing:v2.0.0-stable --reason "canary regressions v2.0.1" --priority urgent --owner sam
```

releasebot: Pin request accepted. Verifying image manifest and policy. Signatures OK. Applying pin and rebalancing traffic (ETA ~30s).

deploybot: Reroute complete. Traffic back to redwood/routing:v2.0.0-stable. v2.0.1-canary scaled to zero.

marco: Thanks. I'll hold the canary artifacts for debug and start a bisect run on the optimizer flags.

ops_oncall: Monitoring: error_rate dropped to baseline ~0.7%, p95 latency normalized. Holding watch for 20m.

tanya: Drafting release note snippet for the rollback: "Pinned to v2.0.0 due to canary regressions in v2.0.1 (routing optimizer). Investigation ongoing; will follow up with postmortem." Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/6270011220

sam: Added JIRA: R-3287 for optimizer regression. Owning triage.

ops_oncall: +22m stable, no further spikes. Closing expedite window and marking thread resolved.

tanya: Marking resolved and adding postmortem owners. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
